Problem: What is the smallest integer greater than 200 for which the greatest common divisor of that integer and 36 is 18?

Solve step by step. End with: The answer is [your answer].

message.content:
For \(\gcd(n,36)=18\), \(n\) must be divisible by \(18\). Write

\[
n=18k
\]

Then

\[
\gcd(18k,36)=18\gcd(k,2)
\]

We need \(\gcd(k,2)=1\), so \(k\) must be odd.

Also \(n>200\), so

\[
18k>200 \implies k>11.11\ldots
\]

The smallest odd integer \(k\) greater than \(11.11\ldots\) is \(13\).

Thus

\[
n=18\cdot 13=234
\]

Check:

\[
\gcd(234,36)=18
\]

The answer is 234.
